description.narrative: Sveriges regering har gett Sida befogenheten att ställa ut garantier till banker i utvecklingsländer, så som Rwanda, som en del av Sidas internationella utvecklingssamarbete i syfte att stödja ekonomisk, social och miljömässigt hållbar utveckling, som genomförs för att bistå utvecklingsländer. Som ett resultat av detta syftar Sida med denna garanti till att: (i) påskynda utvecklingen och finansieringen av små och medelstora företag (SME) i expansions-/tillväxtstadiet, för att driva inkluderande och hållbar ekonomisk tillväxt genom ökat marknadsdeltagande och skapande av jobb, vilket resulterar i fattigdomsminskning, förbättrad försörjning och miljömässigt hållbar ekonomisk tillväxt, och (ii) stödja ökad tillgång till finansiering för kvinnor och ungdomsägda SMEr.

The Government of Sweden has authorised Sida to furnish guarantees as part of Sida’s international development cooperation program for the purpose of supporting economic, social and environmentally sustainable development in developing countries, which is implemented to assist developing countries. As a result, Sida with this intervention, aims to: (i) accelerate the development and financing of Small and Medium sized Enterprises (SMEs) at expansion/growth stage, to drive inclusive and sustainable economic growth through enhanced market participation and job creation, resulting in poverty reduction, improved livelihoods, and environmentally sustainable economic growth, and (ii) support increased access to finance for women and youth-owned SMEs.

The SME portfolio guarantee with I&M Bank Rwanda has been designed as part of an ongoing program implemented by AFR which focuses on development of an inclusive financial sector, including increasing access to credit and capital for SMEs and stimulating innovation in the financial sector. The guarantee is foreseen as one of three components under the Facility and their primary purpose is to act as risk mitigation for mobilize lending to SMEs.
The portfolio guarantees will complement the on-going SME Finance Facility implemented by AFR, which seeks to understand and address the financial constraints experienced by SMEs. The overall goal of the Facility is to support and stimulate the financial sector to better serve SMEs in productive sectors - leading to business growth, improved profitability, and job creation, with an emphasis on job creation for women and youth.
The higher impact objectives of the guarantee, and complementary components, is to sustainably scale-up finance to small and medium enterprises and women and youth-owned enterprises. By targeting economic sectors with high-growth and job creation potential, as well as sectors important for a transition towards green growth, it is expected that the Facility and the guarantees will contribute to private sector development, increased creation of productive jobs and contribute to a more environmentally sustainable and inclusive economic development.
The agreement was signed early 2024 therefore, it is too early to report any results.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
